title: Brisas del Malecón
lyrics:
Next Track: "Brisas del Malecón" (Redone – Full Detailed Suno v5.5 Prompt)
Style: High-energy Spanglish promo, happy hardcore + reggaeton/dembow fusion, male/female duet, 336 Hz tuned, uplifting beach party vibe for Brisas Marinas & San Juan del Sur.

1. Suno Style Tags (Bypasses Filters)
text160 BPM, 4/4 time, happy hardcore meets reggaeton dembow, energetic electronic pop, bright euphoric synth leads, Spanglish male/female duet, driving dance bassline, uplifting party beach vibe, 336 Hz tuning, tropical Nicaraguan essence, sunset energy
2. Structured Lyrics Prompt
text[Intro]
(0:00 - 0:15)
[Fast euphoric happy hardcore synth hook + dembow drums kick in]
¡Brisas Marinas!
Malecón vibes...
San Juan del Sur... Let's ride!

[Verse 1 - Male Vocals]
(0:15 - 0:45)
Walking the malecón, waves crashing near,
Brisas Marinas calling, crystal clear.
Fresh ceviche exploding with lime,
Lobster grilled perfect, every time.
40 metros north of Hotel Estrella,
Sunset views that make you stay forever.

[Verse 2 - Female Vocals]
(0:45 - 1:15)
Desayunos por la mañana con jugos naturales,
Happy Hour alitas, Nica Libre in the air.
Mariscos frescos, family all around,
44 años de sabor en este paraíso found.
Reserva ya, no te quedes afuera,
The best spot in San Juan, pura vida entera.

[Chorus - Duet Harmony]
(1:15 - 1:45)
[Hardcore synths explode, heavy dembow drop]
¡Brisas del Malecón! Sabor del mar,
San Juan del Sur, ven a celebrar.
Atardecer naranja, música y pasión,
Brisas Marinas — this is our song!
¡Brisas del Malecón! Feel the breeze,
Mariscos y amor bajo las estrellas, please!
The heartbeat of the beach, pure energy,
Brisas Marinas — come and feel free!

[Bridge - Instrumental Climax]
(1:45 - 2:15)
[Epic happy hardcore synth solo + rapid reggaeton dembow fills, beach wave layers]

[Verse 3 - Male + Female Trade-off]
(2:15 - 2:35)
Male: WhatsApp 8859 0305, call right now!
Female: Teléfono 2568 3014, don't miss out!
Both: Mar y Tierra special for two, wine and dessert too,
San Juan magic, me and you.

[Final Chorus - Duet, Bigger]
(2:35 - 3:10)
¡Brisas del Malecón! Sabor del mar,
San Juan del Sur, the best by far!
Sunset glow, fresh seafood flow,
Brisas Marinas — let's go, let's go!
¡Brisas, Brisas! Feel the ocean call,
In San Juan del Sur we give our all!

[Outro]
(3:10 - 3:40)
[Dembow slows, synths echo with waves + 336 Hz hum]
Nica Libre in hand...
Right on the malecón...
Brisas Marinas...
San Juan del Sur... forever.
